{{Quote|Skytroopers won't be far behind us. We need to hide the evidence of our landing.''"<br />"''I'll scavenge, you bury?''"<br />"''Just like Arron Prime.|Lana Beniko and Koth Vortena|<ref name="KotFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}}</ref>}}
'''Arron Prime''' was a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy, the fugitives [[Koth Vortena]] and [[Lana Beniko]] were pursued by [[skytrooper]]s on Arron Prime, and were forced to scavenge and bury evidence of their presence in order to evade their pursuers.<ref name="KotFE" />
